Set up. Every weekday at 17:30 Chicago time (22:30 UTC, since this host runs on UTC), the job will post a "Pod end of day" note in #strategic-pod listing that day's new messages there. I confirmed it in the channel as a reply to your message.

The Hermes gateway isn't running on this host, so the job is saved but won't fire until the gateway is started. The first run would be today at 17:30 Chicago time (22:30 UTC).
